messages:
Alicia (partners_pm): quick kickoff — I want to run a 2-day rapid-ramp for a couple SI partners: virtual labs + a lightweight cert so SIs can be marketplace-ready. Proposed dates: Apr 12 & 14. Need owners for: sandbox creds, lab content, cert rubric, and a short joint-announcement blurb. @Marco @Priya can you weigh in?
Marco (partner_eng): sounds good. do we have constraints on infra? GPU quotas, ephemeral creds, telemetry?
Priya (solutions_arch): goal for labs: 3 hands-on exercises (marketplace provisioning, end-to-end deploy from demo app, basic on-prem airgap test). Link to draft lab plan: https://redwood.ai/partner/si-rapid-ramp-labs (WIP).
Ben (marketing): timeline question — do we want a coordinated announcement with marketplace listing? if so we need an embargo window. I can draft a 2-sentence blurb + short customer-friendly bullet list.
James (enablement_lead): cert format proposal: short practical task (30m) + 15 MCQs (20m). pass threshold 80%. open-book allowed for docs-only? recommend closed-book for practical.
Alicia (partners_pm): agree on coordinated announcement. Ben, aim for an embargoed blurb by EOD Fri. James, can you paste a rubric snippet?
James (enablement_lead): sure — here's a minimal scoring rubric:
```
Practical (50 pts): provisioning & smoke test 30 pts, integration with Redwood API 20 pts
MCQs (50 pts): 15 questions weighted, 80% to pass (>=80/100)
Retake policy: 1 immediate retake, then 7-day cooldown
Proctoring: self-report plus automated logs; escalate failures to partner success
```
Marco (partner_eng): for sandbox: we'll create ephemeral API keys tied to partner orgs, quotas: 100k tokens/day per partner for the event. Network: allowlist our lab runner IPs. I'll own sandbox provisioning.
Priya (solutions_arch): I'll finalize the lab exercises and sample answers. Need a template for test data and a small demo app tarball. Req: one cloud marketplace flow, one Dedicated flow, and a smoke on-prem test (airgap checklist).
onboarding-bot: reminder — create marketplace listing draft in /marketing/partner-templates by 1795110000
Ben (marketing): draft blurb (for review): "Redwood + SI Partners: Streamlined onboarding to deploy and certify integrations in under a week. Join our rapid-ramp labs to get marketplace-ready, validated, and certified." I'll attach 2 CTA variants in the doc.
Alicia (partners_pm): volunteers? Marco -> sandbox, Priya -> labs & demo app, James -> cert rubric & scoring, Ben -> announcement + marketplace draft. I'll own partner comms and schedule invites.
Marco (partner_eng): noted. I'll post sandbox access YAML snippet here when ready.
Priya (solutions_arch): ETA for lab content: Tue COB (two days before event). Need SME review from eng-runtime for the on-prem checklist. @eng-runtime please eyeball.
Ben (marketing): timeline check — to hit Apr 12 we need the embargoed blurb by Fri, feature images by Mon, and marketplace draft by Mon noon.
James (enablement_lead): test proctoring tool: we'll use automated logs + recorded session upload for the practical. simple pass/fail signal emitted to partner portal.
Alicia (partners_pm): ok locking dates tentatively. Everyone add deliverables to the project board and @Alicia when done. Any final blockers?
Marco (partner_eng): none from infra side. just need quota approvals (I'll ping infra). :thumbsup:
Priya (solutions_arch): one ask: can we get 2 engineer seats on Dedicated to validate scaling test? if yes I'll schedule.
Alicia (partners_pm): noted — I'll request seats from Capacity team. Thanks all — next sync Fri 10am to triage final assets. :rocket:
